III.  Residential Flood  
A $1,000 deductible applies to any property damaged by the peril of flood, which is located in a “V” zone 
with the elevation of the lowest floor below the Base Flood Elevation (BFE) defined in the Federal National 
Flood Insurance Program.  A $750 deductible applies in all other zones. 
IV.  Commercial Flood  
A $1,000 deductible applies to any property damaged by the peril of flood, which is located in a “V” zone 
with the elevation of the lowest floor below the Base Flood Elevation (BFE) defined in the Federal National 
Flood Insurance Program.  A $750 deductible applies in all other zones. 
V.  OPTIONAL FLOOD DEDUCTIBLES  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
VI. CBRA and Nonparticipating Community Flood Coverages - Residential or Commercial  
A $2,500 deductible applies to any property damaged by the peril of flood in any CBRA or Nonparticipating 
Community.  An optional deductible of $5,000 is available at 0.90 factor.
